**Supplementary Table S2.** Records failing each check in the 2017–2019 cohort (88,234 stays), as exported and after the baseline mapping. Every record the measures use is checked: glucose results, administrations of drugs in either measure's value set, diabetes diagnoses and stay encounters. Only applicable check and record pairs are shown. For stay encounters the code check asks for any SNOMED CT encounter type (an observation-typed stay is correctly mapped); whether the type is inpatient is the last row. The two eMAR checks are specific to MIMIC's medication record and are not changed by mapping.
